---
title: Installation
---

All three distributions are installed from the repository until wheels are
published. The `liberty-tools` name on PyPI belongs to an unrelated project.

## Requirements

- Python 3.14 or newer
- Rust toolchain with `cargo`, plus a working C/C++ compiler — the parser is a
  PyO3 extension and is built from source
- [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) for the checkout workflow

## Install from GitHub

With `pip`:

```bash
python -m pip install "git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git"
```

With `uv`:

```bash
uv add "liberty-tools @ git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git"
```

To install the `liberty-view` and `liberty-tools` commands globally:

```bash
uv tool install "liberty-tools @ git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git"
```

LEF and DEF are separate distributions in subdirectories of the same
repository:

```bash
uv add "lef-tools @ git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git#subdirectory=lef_tools"
uv add "def-tools @ git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git#subdirectory=def_tools"
uv tool install "lef-tools @ git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git#subdirectory=lef_tools"
uv tool install "def-tools @ git+https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git#subdirectory=def_tools"
```

See the [LEF guide](lef.qmd) and [DEF guide](def.qmd) for their commands and
Python APIs.

## Develop locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/smprather/open-eda-file-tools.git
cd open-eda-file-tools
uv sync --dev
uv run maturin develop --release
```

`maturin develop` rebuilds the Rust extension. Re-run it after changing
anything in `src/`.

LEF and DEF each keep their own virtualenv and lockfile:

```bash
cd lef_tools
uv sync --dev
uv run maturin develop --release

cd ../def_tools
uv sync --dev
uv run maturin develop --release
```

## Verify

```bash
uv run python -c "import liberty_tools as lt; print(lt.__file__)"
uv run liberty-view --version
uv run liberty-tools --version

cd lef_tools
uv run python -c "import lef_tools as lt; print(lt.__version__)"
uv run lef-tools --version

cd ../def_tools
uv run python -c "import def_tools as lt; print(lt.__version__)"
uv run def-tools --version
```

The package also ships `py.typed` and `.pyi` stubs for editors and type
checkers.
